interior.title: Remodelación Interior

interior.seoDesc: Renueva tu cocina, baños y áreas comunes con mano de obra premium en Texas. Solicita tu cotización gratuita hoy.
interior.longDesc: Servicios personalizados de remodelación interior. Nos especializamos en renovaciones de cocinas de lujo a medida, transformaciones de baños tipo spa y rediseño espacial completo.

benefits.b1Desc: Detalles hechos a mano, selección de maderas premium y pinturas de alta calidad.
benefits.b2Desc: Rediseñamos los planos de planta para maximizar el flujo de luz natural y la capacidad de la sala.

faq.q1: ¿Cuánto suele tardar una remodelación de cocina?
faq.a1: Una remodelación de cocina personalizada suele tardar entre 3 y 5 semanas, dependiendo de la distribución y la integración de electrodomésticos.
faq.q2: ¿Debo desocupar la casa durante las obras?
faq.a2: No, aislamos las zonas de polvo y creamos accesos temporales para minimizar las molestias en tu vida diaria.

flooring.title: Flooring
flooring.seoTitle: Premium Hardwood, LVP & Tile Installation in Kyle, TX
flooring.seoDesc: Professional flooring installations. Hardwood, engineered plank, vinyl tiles, and large format custom masonry tiling.
flooring.longDesc: Update the foundation of your space's design. We install high-end solid hardwood, engineered wood, luxury vinyl planks (LVP), and custom tile layouts for kitchens and baths.

benefits.b1Desc: Flawless spacing, subfloor preparation, and trim transitions.
benefits.b2Desc: Highly durable modern planks perfect for high-traffic or damp areas.

timeline.step1Desc: Removing old flooring, leveling and cleaning the subfloor.

timeline.step3Desc: Installing matching baseboards, transition strips, and shoe molds.

faq.q1: Do you install flooring over existing tile?
faq.a1: Depending on height and subfloor stability, some LVP can be floated over tile, but we generally recommend removing old layers for the best result.
faq.q2: How long does wood floor installation take?
faq.a2: Most typical rooms take 1-2 days, while full home installs can range from 3 to 5 days.

modern-texas-remodel.title: The Texas Modern Oasis
modern-texas-remodel.seoTitle: Modern Kitchen Remodel in Austin, TX | Canito Construction LLC
modern-texas-remodel.seoDesc: Explore our luxury kitchen transformation in Austin. Features Calacatta marble, custom oak trim, and top-tier finishes.
modern-texas-remodel.descShort: Complete structural layout conversion and luxury kitchen design in Austin, TX.
modern-texas-remodel.descFull: This project involved removing a central load-bearing brick wall to merge an outdated partitioned kitchen and dining room into a unified, open-concept luxury layout. Using premium materials including Calacatta marble countertops and customized solid oak framing.
modern-texas-remodel.challenges: Merging structural spans without support pillars and routing mechanical venting invisibly.
modern-texas-remodel.solution: Inserting a 22-foot structural steel I-beam flush with the ceiling frame, and custom routing exhaust vents through the joists.
modern-texas-remodel.benefits: Maximized daylight flow, double the cabinet storage capacity, and seamless traffic routing.
modern-texas-remodel.testimonial: Canito Construction LLC convirtió nuestra cocina en una obra de arte. Ejecución impecable.

slate-spa-remodel.title: Slate & Spa Bath Remodel
slate-spa-remodel.seoTitle: Charcoal Slate Bathroom Renovation in San Marcos, TX
slate-spa-remodel.seoDesc: A premium spa-like bathroom transformation. Large format slate tiles, LED mirrors, and luxury gold details.
slate-spa-remodel.descShort: Spa-like bathroom build with custom slate tiles and gold details in San Marcos, TX.
slate-spa-remodel.descFull: We transformed a cramped main bathroom into a spa-like retreat. Features floor-to-ceiling textured charcoal slate tiles, a freestanding soaking tub, floating vanities, and warm indirect LED accent lighting.
slate-spa-remodel.challenges: Leveling the subfloor for large-format slates and creating absolute waterproof seals behind stone layers.
slate-spa-remodel.solution: Applying multi-stage self-leveling mortar and a double layer of high-performance liquid membrane waterproofing.
slate-spa-remodel.benefits: Anti-slip slate flooring, spa-like freestanding bathtub, and smart LED ambiance.
slate-spa-remodel.testimonial: El sellado del agua de la ducha y la alineación de las piedras son perfectos. Trabajo profesional.

facade-renovation-kyle.title: Modern Facade Renovation
facade-renovation-kyle.seoTitle: Luxury Exterior Siding & Remodeling in Kyle, TX
facade-renovation-kyle.seoDesc: Explore this exterior remodeling project in Kyle, Texas. James Hardie siding, cedar paneling, and modern lights.
facade-renovation-kyle.descShort: Exterior siding and modern wood facade upgrade in Kyle, TX.
facade-renovation-kyle.descFull: This facade upgrade stripped old wood siding, replacing it with durable James Hardie fiber-cement siding coupled with natural cedar wood panels for a warm modern aesthetic.
facade-renovation-kyle.challenges: Aligning cedar panel trim lines over uneven original exterior framing.
facade-renovation-kyle.solution: Installing a custom shimming rail system to establish a laser-flat plane before mounting cedar siding.
facade-renovation-kyle.benefits: Class-A fire protection, insect resistance, and striking architectural street appeal.
facade-renovation-kyle.testimonial: La fachada de madera se ve hermosa. Cambió el aspecto de nuestra casa por completo.
